method: Read every article's outlet, time, title and RSS description, grouped into loose embedding-similarity blocks only to make reading manageable; every event decided by hand against EVENT_DEFINITION.md. Production event ids were not used. Second pass reviewed all 65 cross-event pairs with cosine >= 0.62.
caveat: Model-made labels, not human ground truth. Spot-check a sample before relying on small differences; notes mark uncertain decisions.
